necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of unexplained syncope and suspected arrhythmia.
